## Change

- [ ] I described the behavior or documentation change.
- [ ] I kept the change focused.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests, checks, or build.
- [ ] I verified the result and noted any limitations.
- [ ] I confirmed no secrets, credentials, or `.env` files are included.

## Security

- [ ] If Gitleaks reports a finding, I verified whether it is real.
- [ ] Any confirmed false positive has a narrow, documented `.gitleaksignore` entry.
